Complex multi-method smoothing with custom enumerations requires manual translation of indicator logic.

other_exits: Historical bar scan from SignalBar+1 onward searches for last opposite signal to determine if a close signal exists when no direct close signal found on current bar - this is a lookback close-confirmation mechanism

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative MM value = fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 means 0.1 lots). Positive MM value = fraction of deposit per deal. Logic handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a Recount mechanism - if CopyBuffer fails, Recount is set true and the next tick retries. The historical bar scan (lines 179-205) searches backward from SignalBar+1 to find the last signal direction when both buy-open and buy-close (or sell-open and sell-close) permissions are enabled but no close signal was found on the current signal bar. This ensures the EA knows the last trading direction to decide whether to close positions. The trade functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) are entirely encapsulated in TradeAlgorithms.mqh, which also handles the MM lot calculation logic. Signal is read from bar index specified by SignalBar input (default=1, previous bar).
python_conversion_notes: Must reverse-engineer or port the ColorX2MA-Parabolic custom indicator which combines dual-smoothed X2MA with Parabolic SAR-like bands. The SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library contains 11+ smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA) - each requires separate Python implementation. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be analyzed to extract the BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen logic including the MM parameter interpretation (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction). The historical bar scan exit logic must be carefully replicated - it iterates backward from SignalBar+1 looking for the most recent opposite signal to determine close signals. Deviation_=10 points used for slippage control. StopLoss=1000 and TakeProfit=2000 are in points (not pips), so digit-adjustment awareness is needed for 5-digit brokers.
